measurement_notes.seasons: Year ending the season. Play-in and NBA Cup finals are outside the archive.
measurement_notes.units: All times are elapsed game clock unless labeled clock or seconds left. The mean of a Boolean measure is its observed frequency.
measurement_notes.roles: Starts tonight. Star proxy also averages 30+ minutes and 22+ points and starts at least half of eight or more earlier regular-season games played. Sixth man is the highest prior-minutes-per-game reserve who appeared tonight and has five or more prior games.
measurement_notes.close: Live absolute margin at most five during the final five minutes of regulation.
measurement_notes.top_eight: Ranked by regulation plus overtime minutes for each team in its regular season.
measurement_notes.fits: Fit on the two older regular seasons. Probabilities add 20 league-average observations per cell. Medians use the pooled training median if a cell has fewer than 20 examples.
measurement_notes.take_fouls: Strict subtype 28. A sensitivity includes generic non-shooting personals within five game seconds of possession entry.
measurement_notes.two_for_one: First field-goal attempt with 25+ seconds left on possession gained at 30–42 seconds.
